part_b_t009_r001_trace.why_wrong_won: IS 12457 is 'Code of practice for evaluation, repairs and acceptance limits of surface defects in steel plates and wide flats' (MTD 04, Metallurgical). It passed the Applicability Gate because tender contains 'Repairs and Maintenance', matching 'repairs' in title. Because tender contains 'Repairs', is_work_or_repair_req=True, bypassing Fix 2A. Both IS 12457 and IS 732 got Medium confidence. Tie was broken by Stage 1 idx (IS 12457 was RRF rank 3 -> idx 0, IS 732 was RRF rank 10 -> idx 5). The system lacks a domain conflict mechanism between Metallurgical/Plate manufacturing (MTD) and Electrical building wiring (ETD).
